rationale: Candidate default permits at most 32 charge source partitions only on SM 12.0 angular classes with at least 8192 primitives. Complete partials must fit the existing dead orbital-potential allocation; other devices, short work and insufficient capacity retain one partition. Explicit 1..64 overrides remain owner-frozen. No new device allocation, screening, metric or precision change. Independent long-contraction, force, graph, resource and sanitizer gates pass. The retained SM 12.0 archive qualifies 242 complete calls; five paired water96 DF processes give r2SCAN-3c cold/warm gains of 18.817%/19.466%, while PBE/PBE0 have no measured gain. Both arms enable the optional validation GEMM feature. Seven-method Direct/DF Standard/Fast, moved and larger-size gates pass; no all-method GPU4 parity claim is made.
revisit_condition: Do not broaden devices, reduce the work threshold or promote performance claims without source-matched independent and complete endpoint qualification. Retain explicit rollback and constrained-capacity behavior.
